query: What reasons or compliance risks appear in declined expenses?

per_column.name: decline_reason
per_column.rationale: Captures the specific reason category for the decline (approval process, not-approved, compliance issue, non-standard). This is a genuine 'aspect of' the decline reason concept -- the substantive ground for declining.

per_column.name: compliance_risk
per_column.rationale: Enumerates the compliance-risk dimensions (high value approval, asset tracking, sensitive department, policy violation) that constitute part of why expenses are flagged/declined. It is an aspect of the reasons-and-compliance-risk concept, not an external predictor. Its multi-valued pipe encoding overlaps somewhat with decline_reason (e.g., asset/travel compliance appear in both), weakening exclusivity.

per_column.name: is_declined
per_column.rationale: A binary flag of whether the row is declined. This is the whole condition under which the concept applies, not a facet OF the decline reasons; it restates membership rather than decomposing the reason into aspects.

judge.rationale: Two of the three columns (decline_reason, compliance_risk) are genuine meronymic facets of the declined-expense-reasons concept, decomposing it into the substantive ground for decline and the associated compliance-risk aspects. However, is_declined is a restatement of membership in the concept, not a facet of it. Mutual exclusivity is only moderate because decline_reason and compliance_risk share overlapping content (asset approval/tracking, travel compliance, service compliance/agreement appear in both), so they do not cleanly carve non-overlapping aspects. Exhaustiveness is moderate: reason type and compliance risk cover major aspects, but other constitutive facets (e.g., severity, responsible party/policy referenced, remediation status) are absent.
